title: rules.version.retire-requested.v1
description: Written to the Rule Engine outbox in the transaction where a retirement of a published version is requested in four-eyes mode (POST .../versions/{v}:retire with horus.bpm.lifecycle.retire-approval: four-eyes, or for the last version in effect with retire-last-version: four-eyes; PD-080, RLE-038). The version stays PUBLISHED and keeps serving until another rules:approve holder confirms with :confirm-retire, which writes rules.version.retired.v1. The request instant is occurredAt. The outbox row id is the event id. Carries the full event envelope. Additive changes only within v1 (DESIGN section 3.3).

eventId.description: The event id, a ULID; equal to the outbox row id. Consumers de-duplicate by it.

occurredAt.description: When the state change committed, ISO 8601 UTC.

tenantId.description: The tenant, from the authenticated context; never from a request body.

correlationId.description: The caller's correlation id (X-Correlation-Id, or the one passed to the Java API). When the caller gave none, the event id: the event starts its own chain.

causationId.description: The id of the command or event that caused this one, or null when a caller's command caused it directly.

producer.description: rule-engine, a slash and the engine version that wrote the event.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the envelope layout; 1 for every .v1 type.

version.description: Version number of the version to retire, not the lock version.

actor.description: Who sent the command; always equal to requestedBy.

requestedBy.description: Who requested the retirement; never the identity that confirms it.

reason.description: Why the version is to be taken out of service; recorded again on the retirement. At most lifecycle.reason-max-length characters.
